title: Invulnerable Pets
description: A simple datapack that makes named pets invulnerable.
body:
This datapack turns named pets invulnerable, so you don't need to worry about issues like them clipping into walls and suffocating (which has happened on my server a few times, sadly...)

This pack uses the `#minecraft:followable_friendly_mobs` tag to determine which entity types are pets - see the list [here](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Entity_type_tag_(Java_Edition)#followable_friendly_mobs).
